text:
jordan: Quick sync — I ran the first batch of Llama-3-12B quantized (4-bit PTQ) with our ‘tight-prefetch’ speculative path enabled. Throughput up ~1.9x on p4d but a few quality blips on long-form prompts.

maria: nice. do you have the perf numbers and which prompts regressed?

jordan: perf: median latency down 48ms -> 26ms per token for seq len 1024 under 16 concurrent streams. p50/p95 improved. throughput from 18 -> 34 tokens/sec.

jordan: regressions mainly on code-completion and math-heavy prompts — token-level perplexity spike around 120-160 context windows.

kevin: is the speculative prefetched KV being used too aggressively? could be stale cache leading to sampling bias.

jordan: I suspected that. The prefetch window currently grabs next-8 tokens predicted by top-k heuristic. if distribution is wide, prefetch hurts.

lena: can you paste the config?

jordan: sure:

```
prefetch.enabled = true
prefetch.strategy = "tight" # top-k=8, temp=0.8
prefetch.max_lookahead = 8
kv.expiry_ms = 30
speculative.fallback = true
```

maria: ops-bot started a canary earlier?

deploy-bot: canary started for branch `tight-prefetch-llama3-4bit` on cluster `gpu-canary-3` at 2026-03-20T09:12Z. 50 sessions routed.

kevin: try reducing lookahead to 3 and add an entropy gate (only prefetch when top-1 probability > 0.6). that should cut bad prefetches.

jordan: good idea. will run A/B: lookahead=3 + entropy gate vs baseline (no speculative).

lena: also run quantization sweep: 4-bit PTQ vs 5-bit and qlora-merged. maybe quantization interacts with speculative because logits shape changed.

jordan: on it. quick matrix I'm running:

- variant A: 4-bit PTQ + prefetch lookahead=8 (current)
- variant B: 4-bit PTQ + lookahead=3 + entropy gate
- variant C: 5-bit PTQ + lookahead=3 + entropy gate
- variant D: 4-bit QAT-ish (per-channel) + no prefetch (control)

maria: for eval, please include our codebench (code-davinci-family mimic) and math-evals, and use n=200 seeds each. measure pass@1, exact match, and answer-fluency delta. also track token-level KL to fp16 baseline.

jordan: will do. one note: when I force greedy decode on prefetched tokens the error reduces but latency benefit drops. so prefetching + stochastic sampling is the risky combo.

kevin: logging checklist: enable trace for KV hits/misses, prefetch decisions, and whether fallback occurred. add a small flag `speculate.reason` to tag events: "entropy_too_high", "cache_hit", "fallback_due_to_divergence".

jordan: added those tags to the trace. sample log snippet: 

```
[ts=289123456701] session=abc123 prefetch.decide top1=0.71 lookahead=3 -> prefetch=TRUE reason=top1
[ts=289123456702] session=abc123 prefetch.apply hit=FALSE divergence=0.23 -> fallback
[ts=289123456703] session=abc123 kv.cache_store size=42
```

lena: timeline? can we get quick 24h run and then a focused, smaller quality cohort (n=1000 but restricted prompts) to validate?

jordan: 24h run started 09:20Z, expected finish 09:20Z tomorrow. small cohort next after we inspect logs.

maria: also watch for hallucination modes — speculative can amplify repetitive tokens when top-k gets stale. add a repeat penalty monitor.

kevin: if entropy gate helps, we can try dynamic lookahead: lookahead = clamp(floor(top1*8), 1, 8). that adapts amount to confidence.

jordan: scheduled that variant as E. adding to matrix.

lena: FYI: we saw similar behavior on L3-70B but less severe because bigger model has sharper distributions. 12B is the sweet spot for risky prefetch.

maria: good note. once we have results, let's prepare a short runbook for oncall: when to disable speculative prefetch (error rate bump > 2% or KL > 0.05).

ops: adding those thresholds to the canary monitor dashboard. alert on token-kl > 0.04 over 15min.

jordan: will post the A/B summary in ~26h. thanks all. :thumbsup:

maria: awesome — ping me when the small cohort is ready, I'll start the qualitative triage.

jordan: will do.
